stem: Primary succession occurs when pioneer species move into an area that has no plants. Which organisms are common pioneer species?

options.label: A
options.text: Conifer trees and tall grasses with roots that loosen the soil

options.label: B
options.text: Mosses and lichens that can grow on rocky surfaces

options.label: C
options.text: Grasses and weeds that arrive as seeds carried by the wind and then germinate in rich soil

options.label: D
options.text: Vines and shrubs that help prevent the erosion of shallow soil
